prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset: six full-body character keyframes of Cecilia relaxing onto her belly and then getting up. One action source sheet, NOT a complete pet atlas.
Reference image 1 is the exact canonical Cecilia identity, face, head size/body proportion, delicate detailed 2D anime sprite art and costume. Reference image 2 is the approved original atlas for identity only. Preserve long mint-green hair, green eyes, cream lace head veil/cape, white sleeves, navy pleated skirt with cream lace hem, dark stockings and dark shoes.
Draw a genuine changing physical body pose in each frame; DO NOT squash, stretch, rotate or resize an entire standing character into lying shape. Keep her head consistently sized.
Layout: landscape 3:2 canvas, TWO ROWS of THREE complete figures. Read top row left-to-right, then bottom row left-to-right. Consistent drawing scale throughout, clear transparent gutters and a horizontal empty gap. Each full character including long loose hair, skirt and all shoes must be fully inside its own cell with large margins, never touching neighboring poses or borders.
Six poses:
1 calm normal standing, front-facing smile and relaxed arms, original canonical pose;
2 bending knees and lowering onto a compact kneeling pose, hands reaching gently forward, head still upright with a relaxed smile;
3 lowering onto her belly in a cute compact three-quarter front pose: torso lies horizontally, both elbows/forearms in front, head stays lifted, skirt modestly covers the hips/legs, tiny dark shoes peek behind the skirt;
4 restful belly lie: head resting gently on both folded forearms, soft closed smiling eyes, cheeks slightly squished by hands, long mint hair and veil settle softly beside her body, dark shoes remain visible behind. Body is naturally horizontal, not a scaled blob; no separate floor/pillow.
5 pushing up with both hands and returning to a compact kneeling pose, open green eyes, gentle content smile;
6 standing again in the exact normal pose and size of frame 1.
Feet and knees/resting body use the same ground level per row. Standing posture taller, lying silhouette naturally lower while the head is the same physical size. Hair/skirt follow movement. Keep all clothing modest and intact.
Actual transparent background. No floor, shadow, furniture, cushion, props, letters, numbers, symbols, effects, hearts, stars, motion marks, scene, borders, labels or other characters. Clean whole-body silhouettes with all six faces readable.
qa: Six complete physically drawn standing/kneeling/belly lie/rest/kneel/recover poses. Native contact inspected, no clipped hair/skirt/shoes and no text/props. Whole rows isolated with bundled connected pixels due overlapping row vertical ranges; no source character cropping or scaling. One shared scale, then grounded pose silhouettes translated vertically to common floor y202 because this clip has no airborne poses. Approximate source head heights 180-210px in both rows; head remains consistent while body lies horizontally.
